text:
mike_docs: Quick sync - spotted inconsistent param casing across guides. Some endpoints show `model-name`, others `model`, and a few older examples still use `modelId`. We should pick a pattern and document conversion rules.
sara_docs: I did a pass last week; my preference: use param-case (snake_case) in prose/docs endpoints (`model`, `max_tokens`) and call out SDK idiomatic forms. That keeps curl examples readable.
jordan_eng: technical note: our HTTP API accepts both `model` and `model_id` for backward compat, but logs show more errors when clients send `modelId` (camelCase). We should discourage that in docs.
tess_product: from a product POV, calling out \"canonical param\" is helpful. Can we add a deprecation table: currently accepted, recommended, legacy? Users appreciate a timeline.
elaine_ux: also flag UI text differences — when we refer to \"Model\" in the Console vs in API docs, tone and capitalization differ. We should add guidance: UI label (title case), docs prose (lowercase variable).
mike_docs: agree. Proposed doc snip to include in style guide:
\"Use param-case (snake_case) for HTTP request parameter names in prose and examples. Show idiomatic casing for each SDK (camelCase for JS, snake_case for Python, PascalCase for .NET). If a legacy name exists, document it in a Compat note.\"

sara_docs: can we add a small example showing the same request in curl / Python / JS? e.g.,

curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-1"}'
```

Python:
```
client.generate(model=\"rwd-1\")
```

JS:
```
client.generate({ model: \"rwd-1\" })
```

jordan_eng: looks good. I'll add a note about header-based param normalization we've got in the proxy so folks understand why both forms sometimes work.
tess_product: also call out glossary terms: \"model family\" vs \"model\" vs \"model version\". Add short definitions so people don't conflate them.

mike_docs: can someone run a repo grep for likely variants? regex: `model(_id|Id|\\-name)?|modelId|model-name`.
lighthouse-bot: search results: 62 hits across docs/, 8 in examples/, 5 in sdk-snippets/ -> https://ci/reports/param-casing-2112467890

sara_docs: I'll take docs/, examples. mike, can you pick up sdk-snippets? jordan, can you handle anything that touches generated code samples?
mike_docs: I can own sdk-snippets. Plan: 1) update snippets to use recommended casing 2) add a Compat note in migration/params.md 3) raise a docs-lint rule to flag camelCase param tokens in API reference.
jordan_eng: created a draft code change to the snippet generator; will run tests.

lighthouse-bot: snippet-tests queued for 2112468050.

elaine_ux: one more UX-driven request: add a \"When to be formal\" callout — API reference should avoid contractions; tutorials are OK to be conversational. This will help tone consistency.
tess_product: yes — add that under docs/style/tone.md.

sara_docs: timeline? would love to ship this before the Friday release.
mike_docs: aiming for tomorrow's docs deploy. I'll open PRs and link them to https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/210.

mike_docs: thumbs-up. I'll annotate files I change with tiny TODOs so reviewers can eyeball them quickly.
sara_docs: thanks. Ping here when PRs are open and if you want pair reviews.

mike_docs: will do. thanks all. :rocket:
